name: steep_block_2026-11-05
purpose: Operator 11/05 'can we not open an entry after a sharp rise in the fast %R': 4 of today's 5 never-greens (VMRK +42, CVS +37/+34, EQNR +31) had wr_d5_fast >= 30 at entry vs 1 of 6 others (n=11, post hoc). This replays the question on days the idea never saw. Gate: ai_watch_wr_steep_block_pts (code default 0 = off) refuses an arm whose fast %R rose >= N points over the last 5 closed minutes. PRIMARY steep30 (the H2 threshold, fixed 11/05); steep40 is a dose-response check, not a second chance. Same SCREEN/CONFIRM bars as every sweep (SCREEN: mean day delta > 0 and >= 60% of days better; CONFIRM: mean > 0, day-t >= 1.5, both halves > 0). VACUITY CHECK: the gate must refuse >= 10 arms in the screen days (events wr_steep_refuse in each replay log); otherwise the result is VACUOUS and says nothing. Independent of the forward prereg (wr_slope_forward_prereg.json), which stays the confirmatory test; a replay PASS here earns a skeptic review and a live observe-flag, never a gate straight to live.
